> **These notes are unfinished intentionally.** Students will help build them as we document our work.

## Personal identity

Before we build systems, we start with the people using and creating them.

Think about:

- experiences
- interests
- communities
- skills
- values
- goals
- how you want to be understood by other people

## Group identity

Technical work is rarely individual. Teams develop shared expectations, language, symbols, habits, and ways of communicating.

We will use this idea later when we develop visual identity and logos.

## From identity to design

Identity gives us something meaningful to communicate. That leads into graphic design, animation, technical documentation, and eventually website design.
